videos.title: [이슈] 27일 '삼전닉스 2배 ETF' 출시 앞두고 금융당국 "손실 위험 커" 유의 당부/2026년 5월 25일(월)/KBS
videos.subtitle_summary:

3. 이번 주에는 많은 중요한 이벤트가 발생할 것으로 예상되며, 투자자들은 2일(27일, 28일)을 주목해야 하고, 레버리지 ETF에 대한 교육를 받아야 한다.

videos.title: [오늘의 AI 뉴스 2026.05.25 20시 | AI 보안, 에이전트, 대형 모델 전쟁]
videos.subtitle_summary:

videos.title: 전체 연설: 교황 레오 14세, 바티칸의 폭발적인 연설에서 AI는 "무장 해제되어야 한다"고 경고 | AK1B
videos.subtitle_summary:
1. Pope Leo XIII (14th) delivered a powerful speech about AI, stating it should be disarmed due to its potential threats.
2. The audience appreciates the gift of this encyclical and the Pope's forthcoming words, seeking his apostolic blessing.
3. The Pope expresses gratitude for everyone present, acknowledges the shared expertise in various reflections, and accepts the invitation to collaborate with them on navigating humanity's path amidst artificial intelligence. He also highlights the hopeful nature of being able to listen and understand each other despite differences, as it signifies the gravity of the situation and the church's role in interpreting new developments in light of the gospel and human dignity.

videos.title: 위기의 신세계 그룹…정용진 회장 내일(26일) 대국민사과 [9시 뉴스] / KBS  2026.05.25.
videos.subtitle_summary:
1. 신세계 그룹 회장 정용진은 5월 26일(내일) 대국민 사과를 예고했습니다. 이는 8일 전에 스타벅스의 5.18 탱크데이 사태로 인해 그룹 총수가 등판한 것으로 알려졌습니다.
2. 정용진은 2013년 국회 국정감사에서 공개적으로 사과했던 과거의 신세계 부회장이며, 이번에는 그룹 총수로서 국민앞에 고개를 숙이게 됐습니다.
3. 정용진은 스타벅스가 5.18 민주화 운동 기념일에 부적절한 탱크데이 할인 행사를 했다고 직접 사과하겠다는 것으로 예상됩니다. 이미 사과문을 냈던 정회장이 제차 사과에 나서는 이후 그룹의 주요 현금 창출 원인인 스타벅스에 대한 불매 움직임이 심상치 않다고 판단되었습니다.

videos.title: Shinsegae’s Chung Yong-jin to Issue Public Apology Tomorrow... Was He Informed? Was There Intent?...
videos.subtitle_summary:
1. Shinsegae Group Chairman Chung Yong-jin will issue a public apology tomorrow for the Starbucks Tank Day event controversy on 5/18 Democracy Movement Day in Gwangju, and the company will also release the results of an internal investigation.
2. The intention behind the event mocking the 5/18 Democracy Movement is under scrutiny, as well as whether top executives were informed or gave instructions for the event.
3. The Starbucks marketing team has claimed that their actions were not intentional, and it's expected that the results of a forensic examination of their smartphones will be disclosed. Additionally, there are calls for the National Pension Service (NPS), which holds 20% stake in Shinsegae-owned Emart, to take action due to potential losses to citizens' retirement funds if Emart's stock price drops significantly.

videos.title: Jang Dong-hyeok: “(The ruling party’s) Starbucks boycott will only last until June 3rd... The tar...
videos.subtitle_summary:
1. Jang Dong-hyeok predicts that the Starbucks boycott by the ruling party will last until June 3rd, suggesting they will return to Starbucks coffee after that date. He references the Saenuri Party's opposition to Samsung in 2016 and its quick reversal following the election.
2. The speaker implies that Park Geun-hye's impeachment trial and special investigation are driving public anger, which is being redirected towards Starbucks as a target for the current election.
3. Jang Dong-hyeok calls this election a battle between Park Geun-hye and her supporters (the ruling party) versus the free people, suggesting that the public should decide whether they support Park or Starbucks. He encourages citizens to show their freedom of choice by choosing their own coffee on Friday (the day of the prediction).
